pages.name: Build one attendance system with three tiers

elements.text: Build one attendance system with three tiers
Prevention for everyone, early intervention for the students slipping,
and coordinated case support for the students already in crisis.
Lantern designs the system and trains the site leads;
Illustrative staffing: one attendance lead per site, one district coordinator.
The multi-tiered system of supports comes from Framework for Action (ERIC ED617466, 2017).
